svg.title: Driver Dreamer — V2 logo comparison
svg.desc: Three new Driver Dreamer identity directions. Presentation surfaces only appear in the comparison.

g.text: Luxury, sports and exotic vehicles — red, deep navy and white.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Horizon D
svg.desc: A deep navy capital D is split by a rising racing-red road with a white lane. The single-letter silhouette expresses driving aspiration without repeating the paired racetrack initials from v1.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Horizon D icon
svg.desc: A deep navy capital D is split by a rising racing-red road with a white lane. The single-letter silhouette expresses driving aspiration without repeating the paired racetrack initials from v1.

svg.text: A single D opened by a rising road: an invitation to the next drive.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Panorama GT
svg.desc: An original navy grand-touring car side profile sits beneath an open red horizon arc. Two wheel hubs and simple window openings remain legible at icon size; the body does not represent a specific manufacturer or model.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Panorama GT icon
svg.desc: An original navy grand-touring car side profile sits beneath an open red horizon arc. Two wheel hubs and simple window openings remain legible at icon size; the body does not represent a specific manufacturer or model.

svg.text: A side-on grand tourer under a red horizon, with an open, welcoming silhouette.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Precision Index
svg.desc: A deep navy flat-bottom sports steering wheel opens on the right into three racing-red index tabs. A red central hub unites the automotive and organized-information ideas.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Precision Index icon
svg.desc: A deep navy flat-bottom sports steering wheel opens on the right into three racing-red index tabs. A red central hub unites the automotive and organized-information ideas.

svg.text: A steering wheel opens into three index tabs, connecting driving with discovery.
